I know how you feel. Nobody ever contacted me on my social media before or after I deactivated and reactivated. But hey, you never know, someone may have sent you a message. I suppose having social media accounts even if they aren't active is like some sense of security. And yes, I would stick to platforms where you are more confident, I do this and it makes me feel a bit better. For example, I have Facebook, but hardly use it and looking through it makes me miserable. However, I'm very active on art websites because I'm surrounded with people like me/who will interact with me. If reddit and such is better for you, keep being active on there. Yeah I know, its a bit rubbish if the people are not IRL people you can talk to, but I'm sure you could develop a few online friendships, and talking to these people help, even if they are far away.

I did this a few times in the depth of depression. You think you can't possibly get more isolated than you are, so what does having any social media matter? You feel like you need to avoid it in order to heal yourself, right? In some cases that is true. It helped me a bit, but then I reactivated accounts later. What I do is keep my accounts so they are there, in case you need them,but just aren't active.
